newsitem.title: ROMANIA: KONTIC VISIT TOPS ROMANIA FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.
newsitem.headline: KONTIC VISIT TOPS ROMANIA FOREIGN MINISTRY AGENDA.

text.p: Yugoslavia's Prime Minister Radoje Kontic will start a two-day visit to Romania on Friday, foreign ministry spokesman Sorin Ducaru told a news conference on Wednesday.
Kontic will discuss boosting bilateral economic ties with his Romanian counterpart Nicolae Vacaroiu, Ducaru said.
Other items on the foreign ministry's agenda also included:
* Foreign Minister Teodor Melescanu will head the Romanian delegation to the U.N. General Assembly session on September 17, and will sign the nuclear test ban treaty on September 24.

* Canadian Industry Minister John Manley starts three-day Romania visit on Wednesday, for talks with Romanian Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu, Foreign Minister Melescanu, Industry Minister Alexandru Stanescu, and Communications minister Virgil Popescu.
* Romanian foreign ministry will open polling stations at Romanian embassies abroad for November 3 general election, Ducaru said.
